canonical_profile.name: Killer In The Keep 5E-Compatible Hybrid
canonical_profile.purpose: Use SRD-style D20 resolution and combat while preserving the supplied murder mystery, fixed hero roster, five Game Levels, evidence privacy, traps, monsters, and legacy board-game options.
priority_order: Explicit Killer In The Keep rule
Host ruling that does not reveal hidden information

conversion_rules.ability_checks: Use 1d20 + relevant ability modifier + proficiency bonus when proficient.
conversion_rules.saving_throws: Use 1d20 + relevant ability modifier + proficiency bonus when proficient.
conversion_rules.attack_rolls: Use 1d20 + relevant attack ability modifier + proficiency bonus and compare with Armor Class.
conversion_rules.movement: Every map square is 5 feet. Standard movement uses speed; Legacy movement may use 1d10 spaces.
conversion_rules.legacy_lockpick: Retained as optional: 1d10, 7+ succeeds, natural 1 loses the lockpick.
conversion_rules.dnd_lockpick: Default hybrid: Dexterity check using Thieves’ Tools against the lock DC.
conversion_rules.legacy_theory_check: Optional DC 13 Wisdom check before a room theory.
conversion_rules.default_theory_check: Standing in a solution room is sufficient unless the lobby enables the legacy check.

supported_rules_modes: Killer In The Keep Standard Hybrid
unsupported: No generic D&D edition switching or unrelated-edition conversion tables remain in this folder.
